title: A local closed free model at a maximal-ideal-annihilated generic stalk
statement: Let X be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], i:Z -> X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with Z integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and F a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose the stalk F_x at x=i(genericPoint Z) [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is killed by the maximal ideal of O_{X,x} [def-weil-residue-field]. There are an integer r >= 0 and an open U of X containing x, with an isomorphism (i_*(O_Z^{direct sum r}))|U isomorphic to F|U. No global map or ideal lattice is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01YE, proof through the local free model, before applying Tag 01YB.

proof.text: Take the coherent subsheaf F prime annihilated by the ideal of the closed immersion. Its generic stalk agrees with F by the maximal-ideal-annihilation hypothesis, and it descends as i_*G for a coherent module G on Z.

The finite function-field vector space G at the generic point has a basis of finite rank r. Extend this basis to a map O_Z^{direct sum r}|V -> G|V on a neighbourhood of the generic point, and shrink so that it is an isomorphism.

The monomorphism i_*G -> F with bijective generic stalk is an isomorphism on some ambient neighbourhood. Push the free model forward and use the open X minus i(Z minus V), whose inverse image is V because i is a closed embedding. Intersect the two neighbourhoods and compose the isomorphisms. The zero generic stalk case uses the empty free module.

theorem coherent_generic_local_free_model
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hkill : ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
      (X.presheaf.stalk (i.base (genericPoint Z))),
      ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint Z))).obj F, a • m = 0) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U : X.Opens), i.base (genericPoint Z) ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F)
